title: Runbooks: a written procedure for the recurring problem

videos.script: Some problems come back. The printer that stops after every paper jam. The disk that fills every month. The same five steps, done from memory, a little differently each time. {{back}} A runbook is those steps, written down so that anyone on the team can follow them, including the person on call at night who has never seen the problem. {{written}} This lesson writes one for a stopped print queue, follows it on a real computer, and looks at what makes a step easy to follow and what makes it dangerous. {{follows}} And at the part everybody forgets: keeping it true after the first time it is wrong. {{true}}
